item.airshipvoyage.ship_part.hint: Go to a construction site, aim at the part outline and right-click
item.airshipvoyage.blueprint.hint1: Right-click the ground to place the project (bow points where you look)
item.airshipvoyage.blueprint.hint2: Sneak + right-click near a site: progress; when complete, launch from the slipway
message.airshipvoyage.blueprint.title: Blueprint: %s
message.airshipvoyage.blueprint.howto: Hold the blueprint: an outline shows the spot. Rings need flat solid support and the volume must be clear.
message.airshipvoyage.site.out_of_world: The project does not fit within the world height
message.airshipvoyage.site.overlaps: Another airship or construction site is here
message.airshipvoyage.site.no_support: No support under the rings: %s of %s spots (e.g. block %s %s %s). Level the site
message.airshipvoyage.site.obstructed: The building volume is blocked: block %s %s %s
message.airshipvoyage.site.placed: Project placed. Install parts in the highlighted spots, rings first
message.airshipvoyage.build.completed: Installed: %s. The airship is complete: sneak + right-click with the blueprint to launch
message.airshipvoyage.build.view_blocked: Cannot reach the %s spot: a block is in the way
message.airshipvoyage.build.occupied_ent: %s: someone is standing in the way
message.airshipvoyage.build.launched: Launched from the slipway. The gas cells are empty: fill them (/airship gas 90)
commands.airshipvoyage.no_site: No airship under construction within 128 blocks
commands.airshipvoyage.under_constructio: This airship is still under construction: complete and launch it first
commands.airshipvoyage.no_cells: This airship has no gas cells
commands.airshipvoyage.weighoff: Weighed off: cells filled to %s%% — neutral at this altitude
commands.airshipvoyage.weighoff_heavy: Too heavy: needs %s%% fill, cells filled completely
commands.airshipvoyage.not_complete: The airship is not complete yet (/airship info shows what is left; /airship build complete finishes it)
commands.airshipvoyage.build_completed: All parts installed — ready to launch: /airship build launch
commands.airshipvoyage.unknown_stage: Unknown telegraph stage: full_astern, half_astern, slow_astern, stop, slow, half, full
